verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of stale-flag detection, flag lifecycle or health indicators, or code-reference scanning that links flags to where they appear in a codebase. Tags, protected flags, audit logs and API-based deletion are adjacent flag-management features. They do not identify stale flags or their code references, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase
